svg.title: Figure 3.1: Height counts and target straddlers along the recorded steps
svg.desc: (n6, n4, n2) and u along the height steps from the seed 7302 census stop to bbef1c8e… (example (b)) and from bbef1c8e… to the stall at 2430f4cc… (example (c)), coloured by sub-phase and rule
svg.text: Figure 3.1: Height counts and target straddlers along the recorded steps
H = 6 while n6 > 0, then H = 4 while n4 > 0. At the H6 handoff the target is recomputed for H4; the old H6 u = 0 belongs to the
absent H6 target. A gap means no target. Example (c) restarts the height phase.
Example (b): step 0 to 12, ending at bbef1c8e… . Example (c): the remaining 10 steps, ending at 2430f4cc… . Markers show the
rule; each panel has its own vertical scale.
Committed research evidence · provisional colours · no Windows/DirectX or performance claim
